about: Shipped calls the release check (scripts/overlay-recipes-check.mjs) lets deny. Each entry: file, command (exact, or "*" for a whole operator README), scope (neutral = the #663 classifyForHook check, box = the real-hook box check and the class-diff, any = both), a reason that says why, and Carter's acceptance by name: accepted_by (human:<id>) and accepted_at (YYYY-MM-DD). An entry without acceptance fails the run (awaiting acceptance); an entry nothing matches fails as stale. An optional flip {from, to} narrows an entry to that one decision move in the class-diff. This file is meant to be a protected path (policy.edit, see approval-md#665), so every change to it is Carter's.

entries.reason: operator recipe; an agent run is human-only by design (approval L16259). The script reads $HERMES_HOME/.env, so an agent following --root "$HERMES_HOME" classes policy.core (protected-path) and is denied, which is the correct answer; dropping --root would only dodge the rule. Permanent entry.

Operator README: install lines, env samples and placeholder lines a human runs or reads, never an agent recipe. Refused by the hook at every core since before 0.4.5 (hook-unclassified, hook-unparseable, hook-harness-launch-unruled); #663 already reports them without gating. A whole-file entry is safe only because the corpus is pinned at 63 recipes (ci.yml CORPUS_RECIPES and PIN_CORPUS) and drift fails the job, so a new README line cannot ride the wildcard.
